The Signal Flow shows how the data runs from the rack to every object.
Hover a universe to follow it through the drawing. Click it to pin the route.
The Show switch shows everything, only DMX, only the network, or only the fibres.
Blocks never overlap. Drag a rack or a block to arrange it, and the arrangement is saved per DB. Auto layout puts everything back.
New: a background picture, like a floor plan or a stage plot. Choose a picture, then set the opacity, the size and the position.
It can be one picture for all the views, or its own picture for each view. Fit to drawing makes it cover everything.
